Main industry (NACE): 72.100 Forskning og eksperimentell utvikling innenfor naturvitenskap og teknikk. Registered employees: 47 (as of 2026-07-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue USD 453,000; operating result USD -29,162,000; net result USD -12,673,000; total assets USD 102,717,000; equity USD 94,977,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue USD 453,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Michael Thyrring Engsig; board chair Barbara Helene Hannelore Krebs-Pohl; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.nykode.com. The website describes the company as: "The Nykode Therapeutics platform is built around the Vaccibody molecule: An immunotherapy platform for the future of medicine."
